title: Vital-records embargo matrix (per-jurisdiction) + first cleared set
context: Vital records (birth, marriage, and death certificates) are among the most genealogically valuable sources, but their access is governed by per-jurisdiction privacy embargoes that vary widely — from 25 years to 100 years or more depending on the US state and record type. The project cannot safely use vital records without a per-jurisdiction embargo matrix that documents the exact embargo period for each record type in each jurisdiction. Records still inside their embargo period are excluded. This is a high-risk, privacy-heavy backlog task explicitly flagged as requiring careful per-jurisdiction analysis and privacy reviewer sign-off.
objective: Research and document the vital-records privacy embargo periods for birth, marriage, and death certificates across US jurisdictions, compile this into a machine-readable per-jurisdiction embargo matrix, identify any record set where the embargo has verifiably elapsed for a specific historical date range, and submit that first cleared set to sources/allowlist.yml for privacy reviewer evaluation.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-jurisdiction embargo matrix covers at least 10 US states, documenting embargo periods for birth, marriage, and death certificates in each.
Matrix is machine-readable (YAML or JSON) and references the authoritative statute or regulation for each embargo period.
Any ambiguity in a jurisdiction's embargo period defaults to exclusion (uncertainty -> exclude).
At least one record set identified where the embargo has verifiably elapsed for a specific historical date range, with the legal basis documented.
That first cleared set submitted as a sources/allowlist.yml entry (status: pending) with full embargo analysis for privacy reviewer sign-off.
Privacy reviewer sign-off required before status advances to 'approved'; this task delivers the analysis and pending entry, not an approved extraction.
Embargo matrix and analysis committed as docs/vital-records-embargo-matrix.md plus a sources/allowlist.yml pending entry, via PR.
output: docs/vital-records-embargo-matrix.md — per-jurisdiction embargo matrix with statutory references, plus a sources/allowlist.yml pending entry for the first cleared record set, committed via PR.
